integrity: The primary source was checked through the exact normalization coefficients, two-geometric-tail formulas, rational self-convolution derivatives, and its Jacobian sign-change proof. The new classification is reconstructed from those exact coefficients by symbolic rational factorization and exact Sturm root counts. A packaged checker reproduces the factorization, root counts, source signs, and the isolating interval for the unique real root.
scientific_limitations: The result completely classifies the Jacobian sign only on the real diameter of the explicit Wang-Zhong counterexample. It does not count or exclude nonreal critical points, does not give a global fold topology, and does not establish a universal dilatation threshold for harmonic self-convolution.
title: Unique real-axis fold point in the Dorff ellipse counterexample
